digest.component_or_area: test contract for operation snapshot surface equivalence
propositions: The AC1 snapshot equivalence contract in test_operation_snapshot_surfaces.py does not actually drive the real MCP and reconciler entry points; it trivially re-composes with identical arguments and compares the results, missing the parity bug it is designed to catch

The contract must invoke build_server() + call_tool for the MCP surface and rebar_reconciler.__main__.main() with argv for the reconciler surface, capturing actual compositions through a rebinding of the module-global compose_operation_snapshot

Each surface's recorded snapshot must be anchored to absolute expected content (repo root, envelope version, config keys) in addition to cross-surface comparison, because equal-to-each-other is vacuous if the composer itself is perturbed

The recorder must fire for each surface; an empty capture must fail with an explicit message naming that surface, so a surface that stops routing through the composer goes RED instead of silently passing

Perturbing compose_operation_snapshot to collapse env provenance into project must make the MCP and reconciler surface assertions fail RED, while the pre-change version must stay GREEN under the same perturbation
